_about: Item level of guns (and armour from step 1d), locked in diary/DECISIONS_SEA.md batch 5: drops from later sea regions are stronger, so old gear falls behind. A gun of level L deals base x damage_growth^(L-1). Sea region n drops levels 10(n-1)+1 .. 10n (region_band). The island and the colosseum are capped at level island_cap (= region 1-2 strength: a pony from there is a weak pony): the island's level rises one every rounds_per_level rounds, the colosseum's with its wave. Crates, the mystery box and the upgrade machine roll inside island_band. Guns from before item levels (v1 / v2) count as level 1. ALL NUMBERS ARE PLACEHOLDERS FOR THE DIRECTOR.
